table.retrieve:
SELECT itemname= case item.printable WHEN 1 THEN item.name ELSE 'Counter Sale:'+LTRIM(RTRIM(item.customicode)) END, 
         aliasname=item.customicode, 
         packingdesc=item.packingdesc, 
		area=(select name from area  where area.areacode=customer.areacode),
         accname =  accounts.name,   
		accaliasname=accounts.aliasname,
         address =  customer.address1,   
         address2=  customer.address2,   
         salesman =  users.username,  
		custdruglicno=customer.licenceno,
		custdrugexp=customer.licenceexpiry,
		sman=(select name from salesman where salesman.salesmancode=saleledger.smancode), 
         srbufferinvcode =  saleledger.srbufferinvcode,   
         headerno =  saleledger.headerno,   
         date =  saleledger.date,
         invdiscperc =  saleledger.discperc,   
         misccharges =  saleledger.misccharges,   
         flatdisc =  saleledger.flatdisc,   
         invsalestax =  saleledger.salestax,   
			salecatcode =  saleledger.srcatcode,
         gcode = saledetail.gcode,   
         icode = saledetail.icode,   
         batch = saledetail.batch,   
         expiry = saledetail.expiry,   
         looseqty = saledetail.looseqty,   
         bonusqty = saledetail.bonusqty,   
         packqty = saledetail.packqty,   
         packunits= saledetail.packunits,   
         saleprice= saledetail.saleprice,   
         discperc = saledetail.discperc,  
			itemflatdisc=0,   
         salestax = saledetail.salestax,   
         Id =  saledetail.IDENTITYCOL,   
         posted=saleledger.posted,   
         balance=ISNULL(saleledger.outstandingamt, 0), 
		amt=saleledger.amt,  
		
         unitsalestax = saledetail.unitsalestax,   
         gstperc = saledetail.gstperc,   
         invgstperc = saleledger.invgstperc1,   
         custTaxRegno=customer.salestaxregno  ,
			 saleledger.custrefno,	
			 saleledger.remarks,
			
			custcode=saleledger.custcode,
			LastSaleRecord=
		(SELECT 'Last Est. No.: '+ RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(SS.HeaderInvNo))) + ' Amount: ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(SS.InvTotal, 12, 2))) 
		FROM SaleLedger SS 
		WHERE SS.srbufferinvcode IN 
			(SELECT MAX(S.srbufferinvcode) 
			FROM saleledger s 
			WHERE S.srbufferinvcode < :ar_srbufferinvcode AND 
				s.custcode = saleledger.custcode)),
		LastVouchRecord=
								(SELECT '  L.C. No.: '+ RTRIM(LTRIM(GG.ChkNo)) + ' Amount: ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(GG.Credit, 12, 2))) 
								FROM GLDetail GG 
								WHERE GG.GLRowID IN 
									(SELECT MAX(GD.GLRowID) 
									FROM GlDetail GD, GlHeader G
									WHERE
										G.Date <= (saleledger.date) AND 
										G.VochCatCode=2 AND 
										G.Posted = 'Y' AND
										GD.AccCode = saleledger.CustCode AND 
										G.GlVochCode = GD.GLVochCode))
			
			

    FROM srbufferledger saleledger,   
         srbufferdetail saledetail,   
         accounts,   
         customer,   
         users,   
         item  

   WHERE (  saleledger.srbufferinvcode = :ar_srbufferinvcode ) AND  
         (  saleledger.srbufferinvcode =  saledetail.srbufferinvcode) AND  
         (  saleledger.custcode =  accounts.acccode ) AND  
         (  customer.custcode =  accounts.acccode ) AND  
         (  saleledger.salesmancode =  users.usercode ) AND  
         (  saledetail.icode =  item.icode)    

ORDER BY /* item.customicode,*/
			 saledetail.srbufferinvcode,
			 saledetail.IDENTITYCOL

objects.name: c_totaltax
objects.expression: Round(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) ,2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + sum(c_salestaxval for all) , 0)

objects.name: c_sumsalestaxval
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for all)

objects.name: c_invsalestaxval
objects.expression: Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01),2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  flatdisc  + misccharges  + salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for all ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0)

objects.name: compute_15
objects.expression: sum(Round(( looseqty *   saleprice ) *  ( discperc *  .01 ) , 2)+ (itemflatdisc*looseqty) for all)+ flatdisc +Round(Sum (  c_amount for all ) * ( invdiscperc * .01) , 2)

objects.name: c_amount
objects.expression: (  looseqty   * ( saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty )
